experiment: fixed-grid correlation-selected integer pair repair pilot
scope: L0/L12/L23 x up_proj/down_proj x rows 0,224,448,672 x S0/S1 x alpha1/scalar10 x A/B/C
data: historical v24/v30 search/held, fixed M2-prefix inputs; no P3, new articles, model forwards, GPTQ, whole-model quantization or PPL
initializations: original scalar10 direct-search winner, tie larger alpha
grid: native W4 unsigned codes [0,15], zero=8, G128; immutable original FP32 scales, zeros and int32 g_idx; grid value FP16(FP32(scale*(code-8)))
code_provenance: exact unique bitwise lookup of all 16 known native grid values against saved FP16 weight; no approximate rounding and no claim of original forward code trajectory
C: fresh X_search.double().T@X_search.double()/N FP64, TF32 disabled, undamped complete matrix; FP64 scoring and p; includes cross-group entries; direct output scorer uses FP32 matmul and FP64 SSE
CPU_preparation_amendment: Before any GPU repair results: changed proposed FP32 C construction to FP64 C construction for cancellation accuracy; all objective/graph/budget/acceptance rules unchanged; construction cost is measured

algorithms.A: global best legal +/-1 single-coordinate candidate each complete round
algorithms.B: all singles plus frozen unique random undirected pairs, same pair count as C
algorithms.C: all singles plus undirected union of top2 normalized abs correlation neighbors per nonzero column; tie ascending column; cross G128 allowed

pair_candidates: four both-nonzero offsets (-1,-1),(-1,+1),(+1,-1),(+1,+1); single-offset pair moves deduplicated into shared singles; bounds filter before scoring
candidate_tie: first in deterministic order: singles coordinate then -1,+1; pairs lexicographic edge then offset order
acceptance: predicted delta < -max(1e-14, 1e-8*initial direct search MSE), direct FP32-output/FP64-SSE recomputation strictly decreases and delta discrepancy <= max(2e-6*current MSE,1e-3*abs(predicted delta)); otherwise numerical failure, stop that trajectory, retain explicit status
budget_execution: pause candidate scoring at every node; an incomplete neighborhood carries its minimum forward and accepts only when complete. Early stop/update cap holds state without fake evaluations. Record actual evaluations and unfinished neighborhood at each common allowance.
independence: A/B/C clone same initialization independently; graph frozen once per search target/split, shared across rows/initializations
zero_variance: detect exact constant columns by search min==max; exclude constant and zero-energy columns from both pair graphs, no division by zero; full C retained; singles remain legal (zero-energy delta zero rejected, nonzero constants may single-descend); record both kinds' quantization error
numerical_checks: CPU bitwise zero-modification; GPU zero delta; boundary enumeration; FP64 cross-term toy; every accepted step direct recalculation; p drift at fixed updates 1,8,16,24,32 and final; initial/final direct and quadratic comparison
held: load/score only after all final/budget states saved and SHA256 lock written; no held-dependent choices
coverage: round-robin budget levels across all 12 target/split bundles, all 96 row/init and all 3 algorithms before next node; deadline leaves explicit incomplete rows/checkpoints
cost: synchronized wall seconds by C construction, pair graph, candidate scoring, update, direct recompute, IO; actual evaluation counts separately; elapsed includes warmup/failures/diagnostics
claims: exploratory analysis on old articles; fixed-grid repair/quadratic increments/single descent/pair search are existing ideas; restricted inspired baselines, not official ReQuant/CDQuant reproduction; no MSE to PPL prediction; no automatic followup experiment
